name: creel bridge
description: Lets creel agents drive cross-origin web pages the static creel page cannot reach on its own.

content_scripts.//: Chrome match patterns cannot express a port, so these localhost entries necessarily inject the connector into EVERY localhost page. That is why the real gate is the port-aware origin check in background.js (creelOrigins, default :8420) — a dev server on another port is treated as a stranger and cannot command the bridge. host_permissions stays broad so the bridge can ACT on any site; the two axes are independent. Remove the localhost entries for a production-only build.
